snippet.title: Blossom: The Seed of Life – Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Want to terraform Mars without all of the high-stakes pressure of surviving the harsh environment? The laid-back, chill base-building game Blossom: The Seed of Life might be just what you're looking for. It will be released for PC on March 9. 
Wishlist it (and play the demo!) on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576870/Blossom_The_Seed_of_Life/
